name: gpu-matmul-f32-v1
description: Dense matrix multiply, C = A @ B, given as nested row-major lists. Exists to prove the contract gate is general: same gate code path as the CPU prime contract, different entrypoint, different arity, different comparison mode. Floating-point results are compared with allclose, never with ==.

cases.note: square, symmetric B (identity). The naive functional test everyone writes — and the known-bad passes it.
square, NON-symmetric B. Catches the transposed-B known-bad: it computes A @ Bt = [[17, 23], [39, 53]].
non-square (2x3 @ 3x2). The transposed-B known-bad indexes B out of range here and raises.
float accumulation: 0.1*1 + 0.2*3 == 0.7000000000000001, so exact comparison would wrongly reject a correct adapter. This case is why compare is allclose.
1x1 degenerate case — every wrong implementation in this family still passes it.

known_good.source:
def matmul(a, b):
    rows = len(a)
    inner = len(b)
    cols = len(b[0])
    out = []
    for i in range(rows):
        row = []
        for j in range(cols):
            acc = 0
            for k in range(inner):
                acc += a[i][k] * b[k][j]
            row.append(acc)
        out.append(row)
    return out

known_bad.source:
def matmul(a, b):
    rows = len(a)
    inner = len(a[0])
    cols = len(b[0])
    out = []
    for i in range(rows):
        row = []
        for j in range(cols):
            acc = 0
            for k in range(inner):
                acc += a[i][k] * b[j][k]
            row.append(acc)
        out.append(row)
    return out
known_bad.reason: Transposed indexing on B: it accumulates a[i][k] * b[j][k] instead of a[i][k] * b[k][j], so it computes A @ transpose(B). Output shape is always right, so a shape assertion passes; it is exactly correct for symmetric B (identity, diagonal, covariance-like matrices), which is what a naive smoke test uses; and on non-square operands it indexes B out of range. Only case 2 (non-symmetric square) and case 3 (non-square) catch it — if the gate cannot fail this, the gate does not deploy.
